title: Measure what a forced format costs
statement: Force a strict output format only on kinds of item where its cost has been measured, because it can cut accuracy sharply on reasoning-heavy content while helping classification-like tasks.
example: Forcing a strict output format dropped one model's single-try pass rate from 82.67% to 74.0%, on a day when none of its failures were format failures.
detail: On one day in the AP work, a model's single-try baseline passed 124 of 150 items, and all 26 failures were content failures, none a parse failure (`icloud-work/aptraining/.agent/memory/SESSION_DECISIONS_2026_05_11.md`; `icloud-work/aptraining/.agent/memory/FINAL_PLAN_2026_05_11_v3.md`). Constrained decoding then dropped the pass rate to 74.0%, while a schema set per course and item type gave 84.0%, within noise (`icloud-work/aptraining/.agent/memory/SESSION_DECISIONS_2026_05_11.md`). The project's literature note cites a study in which three of four mainstream models lost 25 to 63 points on a reasoning task in JSON mode, while the same mode helped on classification (`icloud-work/auto-memory-backup/research_constrained_decoding_per_cell.md`). It set strict modes off by default for free-form item types (`icloud-work/aptraining/.agent/memory/MEMORY.md`).
against: A structured-output benchmark cited in the project's strategy review reported about 3% improvement with guidance or constrained decoding (`icloud-work/aptraining/.agent/research/sota_strategy.md`), and in the study behind the 25-to-63-point figure one of four models lost only 0.1 points (`icloud-work/auto-memory-backup/research_constrained_decoding_per_cell.md`). The project's own drop is a single run. Not every model lost: "| Gemini-1.5-Flash | 89.3% | 89.2% | −0.1pp |" (`icloud-work/auto-memory-backup/research_constrained_decoding_per_cell.md`, line 26). The per-type comparison the project recommended has no recorded result.

evidence.quote: UPLIFT-3 constrained decode = 74.0% (-8.67pp, Synapse Item 25 predicted), UPLIFT-3b per-cell schema = 84.0% (+1.33pp, within noise).

26/26 today's failures are `status:fail rating:INFERIOR` with content-quality dimensions zeroed (`factual_accuracy`, `stimulus_quality`, `difficulty_distribution`). **Zero parse_fail.** Format-fragility hypothesis is dead.
JSON mode loses 25-63pp on reasoning tasks; per-cell decision; default OFF for free-form cells.
Three of four mainstream models lose 25–63pp on a reasoning task in JSON mode.
Same paper shows JSON mode *helps* on classification (Gemini-1.5-Flash 41.6% → 60.3% on DDXPlus). **Direction depends on task.**
Three of four mainstream models lose 25–63pp on a reasoning task in JSON mode. **This is a capability tax, not a measurement-fairness adjustment.**

- [Tam et al., *Let Me Speak Freely? A Study on the Impact of Format Restrictions on Performance of Large Language Models*, EMNLP 2024 Industry Track](https://aclanthology.org/2024.emnlp-industry.91/)
